newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee slips at close in kerb, seen weak.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee slips at close in kerb, seen weak.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.25 down at 42.10 to the dollar on Monday on higher dollar demand after last week's profit-taking, dealers said.
"The dollar fell to attractive levels last week which prompted fresh buying today," dealer Owais Kalia said. "Dollar demand is likely to remain high in the coming days."

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last fixed on May 23, was 40.3900/40.5920 against the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed up at 4.0 percent from the previous close of 3.70.
